biography:
As Vice President of Real Estate and Site Development at EdgeConneX, I lead a team focused on identifying and qualifying markets and projects for data center development across the Americas. We specialize in sourcing strategic locations, engaging with key stakeholders, negotiating complex transactions, and preparing sites to be development-ready.My career spans over a decade in the data center and infrastructure industry, including 10 years at CBRE—8 of which were dedicated to data center advisory and transactions. I transitioned to the client side to lead real estate strategy from within EdgeConneX, and later helped to start and scale Voltera, a fleet EV charging infrastructure company backed by EdgeConneX and EQT. After two years of entrepreneurial growth, I returned to EdgeConneX to continue driving digital infrastructure expansion.To date, I’ve executed over $1B in real estate transactions and led site selection, portfolio strategy, and development for Fortune 200 companies and mission-critical infrastructure. I thrive in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments and am passionate about enabling scalable, sustainable infrastructure that meets the evolving needs of our customers and communities—and about building high-performing teams that deliver results that scale.I’m also a proud member of Chief, where I connect with and support other women leaders driving change in the C-suite.
Leading a team working to deploy powered, proximate, and permitted sites across the globe while helping customers, partners, and the community to achieve environmental, economic, and social sustainability.

With deep experience as a buyer and an advisor, including a decade at CBRE, Hannah has proven her ability to execute even the toughest real estate transactions. She has been in charge of sourcing new locations, transaction negotiations, portfolio management, and site due diligence for a broad spectrum of property types, and led advisory and transaction services for Fortune 200 companies. Hannah has personally been involved in closing more than $1 billion worth of real estate transactions.

Hannah now oversees the entire project development life cycle from siting through to commissioning of infrastructure heavy fleet electric vehicle charging sites. This involves the acquisition of highly specialized real estate, qualification and risk mitigation of top locations, technical design work and efficient and repeatable constructure of projects across the US.
